intent: PSI-067: Admin: Integrations page — show the Service Account email, register Drive roots with role/group access, and link Google Calendars with a direction and audience.
summary: Added /dashboard/admin/integrations: a server page gated by requireAnyPermission(['integrations.manage','documents.manage']), a client IntegrationsView with a copyable Service Account banner plus Drive Roots and Linked Calendars tabs, and two dialogs (DriveRootDialog, CalendarDialog). Added six server actions to features/admin/actions.ts (getAdminIntegrationsData, saveDriveRootAction, deleteDriveRootAction, saveGoogleCalendarAction, deleteGoogleCalendarAction, triggerSyncAction), new item types, requireAnyPermission(), one icon, and the Administration nav entry. No migration: consumes the PSI-061 M6 schema as-is. Sync buttons call triggerSyncAction, which posts to Edge Functions owned by PSI-062/065/066 and currently no-ops gracefully since those are not deployed.

changes.note: Server page: permission gate plus data fetch
SA banner, tabs, roots and calendars tables, sync/delete handlers
Add/Edit Drive root with role and group multi-select
Link/Edit calendar with direction and XOR audience picker
Six integrations server actions, each permission guarded
PSI-067 moved to review with review link

decisions.decision: Gate the page with requireAnyPermission(['integrations.manage','documents.manage']) and re-check integrations.manage inside every mutating action
decisions.reason: The page shows data readable by either permission, but only integrations.manage may mutate. UI hiding is not authorization, so each server action enforces its own check.

decisions.decision: Accept a full Google Drive URL in the root dialog and extract the folder id server-side
decisions.reason: An operator copies the URL from their browser; requiring them to hand-pick the id is an avoidable error source.

decisions.decision: Make triggerSyncAction swallow Edge Function failures and report a queued job
decisions.reason: The sync functions belong to PSI-062/065/066 and are not deployed yet, so a hard error would make the whole page look broken. Flagged as a follow-up to revisit once PSI-062 lands.

decisions.decision: Join drive_root_access to roles/groups in memory rather than via a nested PostgREST select
decisions.reason: Keeps the action readable and typed against the generated database types; the row counts here are small.

verification.manual: Ran supabase db reset and bunx supabase test db (6 files, 50 tests PASS); bun run lint (0 warnings, 0 errors on 282 files); bun run typecheck (exit 0); bun run build, which registered the new /dashboard/admin/integrations route. Did not exercise the page in a browser: it requires a signed-in user holding integrations.manage, and no dev server session was established.

human_review.reason: PSI-067 is a user-facing admin page awaiting the operator's visual review and manual stamp to done in Obsidian. Also confirm open question 1: whether the not-yet-functional Sync buttons should be hidden until PSI-062/065/066 deploy.
